Your 3-year-old staring blankly at Grandma instead of saying thank you? Totally normal.

Researchers describe gratitude in four parts: noticing a gift, thinking about why someone gave it, feeling good about it, and then showing it. "Thank you" is only the last step, and the thinking part takes years.

The good news: toddlers are natural helpers. Give them a real Thanksgiving job, notice kindness out loud, and praise their help instead of paying for it.
